To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
cognitive skills and personality are important factors in refugee adjustment.
cognitive and personality factors are important predictors of refugee adjustment.
cognitive factors and personality are important for refugee adjustment.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of how the individual characteristics of refugees influence the process of integration.
the question of what makes refugees more successful in their integration.
the question of how refugees can be supported in their integration process and which individual factors are important in the context of this process.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

refugees who are more willing to reciprocate with their environment, have a more positive outlook, are more open to risks, and have a more external locus of control, are more likely to adjust well to their new environment.
the more cognitive skills and the more personality traits refugees have, the more likely they are to adjust to their new country.
cognitive and personality characteristics are of great importance in the context of refugee adjustment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
cognitive and social resources are the most important predictors of refugee adjustment.

cognitive and personality factors play an important role in the integration of refugees and that they are important predictors of adjustment in the different integration domains (institutional, interpersonal, and intrapersonal).
the more cognitive resources and personality resources refugees bring with them, the more likely they are to adjust to the new country.
The main takeaway from our work is that
cognitive skills and personality traits are relevant for successful integration.
the integration of refugees is a complex and multifaceted process, which is influenced by both individual and contextual factors.
cognitive and personality factors are important determinants for refugee adjustment.
